label: Whatever has the nine SIMPLE_4, PERFECT_2, INFINITE_1 attributes is LIVING_2
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed; the weak version of STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES. Whatever is simple, universally perfect, supremely good, the one GOD_4, infinite, altogether immutable (pure act), eternal, and has intellect and will lives at some time of the duration frame (LIVING_2, LivesSomeTime: its life is present at some time). Not LIVING_1: the passage to the timeless primitive Primitives.Lives is the separate restricted sense bridge 'Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and is LIVING_2 is LIVING_1'. Scoped exactly to what the restated sufficiency NineSufficeForDeiFilius quantifies over; strictly weaker than STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES (Control.Controls part 2). Derived (nineLiveFromSelfOperation) from the weak operation premise, STMT-SELF-OPERATING-UNMOVED-LIVES and the Prima Via premise that nothing is moved except as in potency.
